ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {OTHER_nameDef}'s execution
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A bloodthirsty, cold or grieving colonist wants a captured raider executed. Kind colonists will likely object, and executions upset most people anyway.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} came here to kill us. We patched them up and we feed them three times a day. I don't understand it.
Every meal {OTHER_nameDef} eats is a meal one of us doesn't. End it.
[trigger:raid] The blood's still drying out there, and the one who spilled it is sleeping in our bed. In our cell. Whatever.
[trigger:death] We buried one of ours today. {OTHER_nameDef}'s people did that. {OTHER_nameDef} doesn't get to keep breathing.
[grieving] I keep walking past the cell. Every time, I think about who isn't here because of the one inside it.
[poor] We can't feed ourselves properly, and we're feeding a raider. Do the math.

warm.li: I don't enjoy saying it. But {OTHER_nameDef} will come back with friends if we let them go, and someone I love will pay for it.

blunt.li: Shoot {OTHER_nameDef}. Or give me the gun and I'll do it.
That raider in the cell? I want them gone. Not released. Gone.
[trait:Bloodlust] I've been thinking about it all day. I'd make it quick. Mostly.
[trigger:raid] They came for our throats. Fair's fair.

cheerful.li: Not to be a downer, but I'd love it if {OTHER_nameDef} stopped existing! Then we could all relax!

gloomy.li: We'll either kill {OTHER_nameDef} now, or {OTHER_nameDef} will kill one of us later. I've seen how this ends.
[trigger:death] Nothing brings them back. But I'd sleep, at least. I haven't slept.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} won't join us and won't fetch a decent ransom. Keeping them is waste.
A prisoner costs food, a warden's time and a bed. {OTHER_nameDef} has negative value. Correct it.
[trait:Psychopath] There are other uses for a body, of course. I'm only suggesting the simplest one.

plain.li: It's done. I thought I'd feel better. I do, a little.
{OTHER_nameDef} won't be shooting at anyone else. Good.

blunt.li: About time. Somebody hose the cell down.

gloomy.li: One less of them. There's always another, but one less.

cold.li: Resolved. The cell is available again.

plain.li: Fine. Keep feeding {OTHER_nameDef}. I'll remember who decided that when they come back for us.

blunt.li: Soft. This whole council is soft.

cold.li: A poor decision. I'll note it.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is still alive, by the way. Still eating. Still looking at us through the bars.

blunt.li: That raider's still breathing. Why is that raider still breathing?

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {OTHER_nameDef} set free
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A kind colonist, or one who has made friends through the bars, wants a prisoner released. Recruiting them counts too. The bloodthirsty will object.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {OTHER_nameDef} is no longer a prisoner, and still alive.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} isn't going to join us. Everyone knows it. Let them walk home.
I talk to {OTHER_nameDef} sometimes, through the bars. They have a sister. Did you know that?
We're not raiders. Let's stop acting like it. Let {OTHER_nameDef} go.
[child] I'm not much older than {OTHER_nameDef}. If it were me in there, I'd want someone to say something.
[winter] If we let {OTHER_nameDef} go now, they might not make it home through the snow. So soon, then. Before it gets worse.

warm.li: Whatever {OTHER_nameDef} did, they've paid for it. Please. Open the door.
I know what they came here to do. I also know what it's like to have nowhere to go. Let {OTHER_nameDef} go home.
[trait:Kind] Mercy costs us nothing. Well, a little. It's worth a little.

blunt.li: Either recruit {OTHER_nameDef} or let them out. This in-between is cruel and it's costing us rice.

cheerful.li: Let's set {OTHER_nameDef} free! Who knows, maybe they'll tell their friends we're nice and stop shooting at us!

gloomy.li: Keeping someone in a cage until they rot. Is that who we are now? Maybe it is.

cold.li: Releasing prisoners improves relations with their faction. {OTHER_nameDef} is worth more as a gesture than as a mouth.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} looked back once, on the way out. I think that meant something.
Good. We're still decent people. I was starting to wonder.

warm.li: Thank you. Truly. That's the colony I want to live in.

cold.li: Acceptable. Their faction will note it.

plain.li: So {OTHER_nameDef} stays in the cage. I'll keep bringing them extra bread, then.

warm.li: I hope someone shows us more mercy than we showed {OTHER_nameDef}.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a party
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A sociable colonist thinks the colony needs a party, or everyone is miserable and someone wants to do something about it. Promise it and the council calls one right away, if there's a place to gather.

plain.li: When was the last time anyone here laughed? Not counting the time the boomalope exploded.
One evening. Some food, something to drink, nobody on watch except the turrets. That's all.
We survive all day. Let's spend one night living.
[afterraid] We're alive. That's worth a drink.
[winter] It's dark at four and colder than a grave. Let's light a fire and make some noise.
[lowmood] Everybody's walking around like it's a funeral. Nobody died. Let's prove it.
[lowtech] A fire, a drum, a pot of something. People have been doing this since before there were people.

warm.li: I want to see everyone in one room, not working, not bleeding. Just together for a bit.
[newcomer] Nobody's really welcomed me yet. A party would help. Not for me! For everyone. But also for me.

blunt.li: We need a party before somebody snaps and stabs somebody. I'm not saying who.
Party. Tonight. I'm not asking twice.

cheerful.li: Party! Party party party! Okay, I'm calm. But a party!
I've been saving a joke for weeks. It needs an audience and a little alcohol!
[trait:Industriousness] I'll even work double tomorrow to make up for it! Probably!

gloomy.li: We'll all be dead eventually. Might as well have one nice evening first.
I'm not a party person. But I'm even less of a misery-every-day person. So.

cold.li: Morale is low enough to risk breakdowns. A gathering is the cheapest fix.

plain.li: That was a good night. We should do that more than once a year.
My head hurts. Worth it.

cheerful.li: Best. Night. Ever. When's the next one?

gloomy.li: For one evening I forgot where we are. That's rare.

plain.li: No party, then. Back to work. Always back to work.

cheerful.li: Okay, no party. I'll just... dance alone. In my room. It's fine.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: bringing {OTHER_nameDef} home
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist was kidnapped, and someone who loves them wants them back. It takes a raid on the kidnappers' settlement, a ransom, or a lucky quest, so the colony has a long time to do it.

plain.li: {SUBJECT} has {OTHER_nameDef}. We know roughly where. That's more than most people get.
I keep setting a place for {OTHER_nameDef} at dinner. Then I remember. We have to go get them.
They didn't kill {OTHER_nameDef}. They took them. That means there's still time.
[afterraid] They dragged {OTHER_nameDef} off while we were still shooting. I saw it. I can't stop seeing it.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} would come for any one of us. You know they would. Please.
I don't care what it costs. Silver, guns, a season's harvest. Bring {OTHER_nameDef} home.

blunt.li: We arm up, we walk to {SUBJECT}'s camp, we take {OTHER_nameDef} back. Simple.
Nobody takes one of ours. Nobody.

cheerful.li: A rescue mission! Like in the stories! Except real, and scary, and we have to win. But still!

gloomy.li: Every day we wait, {SUBJECT} has another day to sell {OTHER_nameDef}, or worse.
I know the odds. I don't care about the odds.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has skills we can't replace. Recovering them is cheaper than finding another.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is home. I'm not letting go of them for a while.
We went and got them. We actually went and got them.

warm.li: Welcome home, {OTHER_nameDef}. Your bed's still made.

blunt.li: Told you. Nobody takes one of ours.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef}! YOU'RE BACK! Somebody get a cake! Do we have cake? Get rice!

plain.li: We're not going after {OTHER_nameDef}. Say it out loud, so I know whose voice it was.

gloomy.li: So that's it. {OTHER_nameDef} belongs to {SUBJECT} now. I hope they forgive us. I won't.

plain.li: Every night, I wonder if {OTHER_nameDef} is looking at the same stars.

blunt.li: It's been weeks. {OTHER_nameDef} is still out there. Are we going or not?

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a hunt
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist who loves shooting, or one with blood on the brain, wants to go hunting. Promise it and the council marks an animal for them.

plain.li: There's meat walking around out there on four legs, and I'm in here sorting rocks.
Let me take the rifle out for an afternoon. I'll come back with dinner.
[winter] Food's running thin, and the deer are fat. Let me out.
[lowtech] A bow, a quiet morning and something worth eating. I miss that.
[outside] I just saw tracks by the treeline. Fresh ones.

warm.li: I'd love to bring back something good for the cooks. Everyone's been eating so plain.

blunt.li: I need to shoot something. Better an animal than one of you.
[trait:Bloodlust] My trigger finger itches. Find me a muffalo before it finds one of you.

cheerful.li: Hunting trip! Fresh air, sunshine, and a very surprised deer!

gloomy.li: Out there it's just me, the wind and something that doesn't know it's about to die. Peaceful, in a way.

cold.li: The local wildlife is an unharvested food stock. I'm qualified to harvest it.

plain.li: Clean shot. We eat well tonight.
That's the best afternoon I've had in a season.

blunt.li: Got it. Now somebody else can drag it back.

cheerful.li: I got one! I GOT ONE! Sorry, little guy. Thank you, little guy!

gloomy.li: It didn't suffer. That's more than most of us will get.

cold.li: Kill confirmed. Meat to the freezer.

plain.li: Fine. The animals live. I'll go back to whatever this is.
